info.title: Digital - Custom Chat
info.description: This API facilitates session-based communication. Only "Chat" channel is supported now.

license.name: Avaya Software Development Kit (SDK) Software License Terms

tags.name: Engagements
tags.description: Inbound engagements can be created from the customer side which are then handled by contact center resources like agents, supervisors and bots. Session Id's can be passed on any explicit requests made on engagements so that all the activities can be correlated back to the appropriate session.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Sessions are used to hold context information about the customer and the clients used by the customer. A customer can have multiple active sessions at the same time. Sessions can be passed on any explicit requests made on engagements so that all the activities can be correlated back to sessions that caused it.

post.description: Creates a new client session for the customer. A single customer can have multiple active sessions concurrently. For example, if a customer is logged-in through a mobile device and a computer, activities from both the devices can be represented using two separate sessions.

get.description: Gets the details of an existing session by sessionId.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason for deleting the customers client session

post.description: Appends customer identifiers to an existing session. If the key of the identifier already exists, the new value will be appended to the existing list.

Updates the session parameters of an existing session. If the key of the parameter already exists, it will be updated with the new value else both the key and the value will be added to existing parameters.

Creates a Digital engagement for Custom Chat in the Contact Center. If an engagement already exists for the customer then a new dialog will be created for the existing engagement, otherwise a new engagement and dialog will be created.

201.description: A new engagement or a dialog created

get.description: Lists all the Custom Chat related engagements for a session.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The unique 36 character internal id that represents the session.

get.description: Gets the details of an existing engagement by engagementId. Retrieves only Customer Chat related engagements.

post.description: Disconnects the customer from a specific dialog associated with the Custom Chat related engagement.
Allows a customer to join an active dialog associated with the Custom Chat related engagement.

get.description: List messages that have been exchanged in an active engagement dialog. To receive messages of a live dialog, subscribe using Digital Notification API. Avoid calling this API in a loop. This API is applicable only for Custom Chat related engagements.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The unique 36 character internal id that represents the session.

post.description: Sends a message to the Contact Center on the specified Custom Chat related engagement and dialog.

type.description: An absolute URI that identifies the problem type. When dereferenced, it SHOULD provide human-readable documentation for the problem type (e.g., using HTML).

title.description: A short, summary of the problem type. Written in english and readable for engineers (usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized).

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: An absolute URI that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced.

violations.description: A list of violations that occurred as a result of invalid data provided as part of a request.

field.description: The name of the field in the request that caused the violation. This can be the name of a path parameter, query parameter, or a field within the request body.

message.description: A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the violation.

code.description: The violation code generated by the server for this occurrence of the violation. Use this code when implementing any error handling logic instead of the message, as the message can change.
